[[Knights of San Fernando]] |TV actor = }} '''Brotherhood knights''' are characters in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== {{main|Brotherhood of Steel hierarchy}} In the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] chapter known as the [[Knights of San Fernando]], knights are mid-ranking active duty combatants who are equipped with [[power armor]]. The chapter's [[Aspirant (TV series)|aspirants]] are trained to serve knights as [[Squire (TV series)|squires]]. Aside from various unnamed knights, they are known to include [[Titus|Knight Titus]], [[Gnatius|Knight Gnatius]], [[Riley (TV series)|Knight Riley]], and the [[:File:Shady Sands Knight and Maximus.png|knight]] who found [[Maximus]] after the [[Fall of Shady Sands|destruction]] of [[Shady Sands]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== Several Brotherhood knights arrive at the Brotherhood base from the ''[[The Prydwen|Prydwen]]''. When Maximus is interrogated by [[Quintus|Elder Cleric Quintus]] for the suspicion of Dane's leg injury, a knight participates in it, too, by standing by. Afterward, Brotherhood knight Titus anoints Maximus as his squire as [[Aspirant (TV series)|aspirant]], [[Brotherhood officer]]s, and fellow knights attentively observe the ritual. Eventually, the Brotherhood knights were assigned a [[Squire (TV series)|squire]] and a new assignment to hunt a former [[Enclave]] [[Siggi Wilzig|member]] and his [[CX404|dog companion]] who are in possession of a [[Cold fusion|dangerous device]]. Once they were dismissed, they entered their respective [[vertibird]] and rode off to their assigned destinations. ===[[The Beginning]]=== Arriving in the Brotherhood of Steel usurped [[Filly]], two Brotherhood knights follow Maximus from behind as he carries a [[critic]] head in as his Brotherhood peers glare at him. He then faced a trial and judgment by Elder Cleric Quintus, who would later learn from Maximus about Knight Titus' death. Maximus recalled the Brotherhood knight who rescued him as a child in a brief flashback. Eventually, the Brotherhood of Steel army would invade the [[New California Republic|NCR]] [[Griffith Observatory|base]] of [[Lee Moldaver]]. One Brotherhood knight riding a vertibird alongside Maximus and [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]], fires off a [[Minigun (TV series)|Minigun]] at the base. On land, the Brotherhood knights, most wielding a [[Heavy assault rifle (TV series)|heavy assault rifle]], attacked the [[NCR soldier (TV series)|NCR soldiers]]. Eventually, the Brotherhood knights accompanied by [[Brotherhood soldier (TV series)|soldiers]], [[Brotherhood officer]] [[Shortsight]] and Maximus. Enter the observatory and mow down the NCR soldiers within there until they're accosted by [[the Ghoul]], who catches their attention with a whistle. He comments on how "big" the Brotherhood knights must feel wearing the armor and states that he once wore one in the past. The Ghoul then stated that there was a major flaw in the armor concerning the welding just below the chest plate and wondered if that flaw was fixed in the new model. Firing off a bullet at one of the Brotherhood knights, which instantly kills him. After commenting that the flaw was never fixed, the Ghoul was fired at by one of the Brotherhood knights, who creates a blackout by shooting out a power generator. Using the cover of darkness, the Ghoul kills the Brotherhood knights. In the aftermath of the battle, several Brotherhood knights' corpses are seen laid across the observatory grounds. Later, when Dane, some Brotherhood knights and soldiers find Maximus standing beside the corpse of Moldaver. Dane surmises that Maximus has killed her and, raising his arm, starts chanting Maximus' name, who would become a knight thereafter. ==Appearances== Various unnamed Brotherhood knights appear {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|1=101|8=108|10=202|11=203}} ==Behind the scenes== * Unnamed knights are portrayed by stunt performers. * It is currently unknown whether the higher [[Brotherhood of Steel#Paladin|paladin]] rank known from previous ''Fallout'' games is used among the Knights of San Fernando. {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Brotherhood of Steel characters]]
